name: Tire Flip Sprint
description: A conditioning complex where a heavy tire is flipped multiple times followed immediately by a sprint. The tire flip builds explosive hip extension and upper body power while the sprint develops speed and anaerobic capacity. This combination is a staple of strongman conditioning.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Tire Flip Sprint in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Tire Flip Sprint.
steps: Step 1: Position over tire in deadlift stance with hands under tire.
Step 2: Drive hips and flip tire forward explosively for target distance.
Step 3: After final flip, immediately sprint a set distance.
Step 4: Rest and repeat for target rounds.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Lifting with back instead of legs
Resting too long between flip and sprint
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Drive through legs, not lower back
